'''April 2001 Minneapolis tournament (17 April)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Mirkwood, Minneapolis, Minnesota on 17 April 2001. [[Michael Raveling]] won it. It is known from Garrett Larson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2105">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-18-mirkwood-deadbody-style-apr-17d2105/ mirkwood-deadbody-style-apr-17], DeckTech (garrett "deadbody" larson, 18 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-18-mirkwood-deadbody-style-apr-17d2105/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 17 April 2001
* '''Site:''' Mirkwood, Minneapolis, Minnesota
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Raveling]]
